description: A Flutter widget defining a WebView-based login screen that automates login via JavaScript, handles captcha prompts, observes navigation and page load events, and performs heuristic success detection based on URL changes.

classes.name: WebViewLoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget providing a login interface using WebView, with automation, captcha handling, and navigation control.

methods.name: _WebViewLoginScreenState
methods.description: State class managing WebView initialization, event handling, automation, captcha prompts, and navigation within WebViewLoginScreen.

methods.name: _handlePageStarted
methods.description: Handles WebView page start event, updates status.

methods.name: _handlePageFinished
methods.description: Handles WebView page finish event, sets up automation and field filling.

methods.name: _handleNavigationRequest
methods.description: Decides on navigation requests; currently allows all.

methods.name: _handleWebResourceError
methods.description: Handles WebView resource loading errors, shows snack messages.

methods.name: _initAutomationAndMaybeFill
methods.description: Initializes WebAutomation instance, sets up stream subscriptions, fills login fields, performs captcha detection and auto-submit if applicable.

methods.name: _postFillFlow
methods.description: Handles post-fill actions, including captcha detection and auto-submission.

methods.name: _onCaptchaRequested
methods.description: Triggers captcha prompt dialog, injects user's input into WebAutomation, submits form, and checks for success.

methods.name: _evaluateSuccessAndNavigate
methods.description: Determines login success based on URL heuristics and navigates to home screen accordingly.

methods.name: _normalizeUrl
methods.description: Normalizes URL string, prepends https scheme if missing.
